keys: Kumpulkan koin di jalan untuk belanja.
en: Collect coins on the road to go shopping.

keys: Koin belum cukup. Butuh %d koin lagi.
en: Not enough coins. You need %d more.

keys: Gerak: WASD / panah / swipe   Pause: Esc / P
en: Move: WASD / arrows / swipe   Pause: Esc / P

keys: %s perfeksionis: denda kerusakan 2x. Paket sempurna dan tepat waktu dapat tip %s.
en: %s is a perfectionist: damage fines are doubled. A perfect, on-time package earns a %s tip.

keys: Hujan deras: jarak pandang terbatas dan aspal licin.
en: Heavy rain: limited visibility and slippery asphalt.

keys: Kucing jalanan suka menghalangi jalan. Cari jalur lain!
en: Street cats like to block the way. Find another path!

keys: Bang Kilat, kurir rival, suka ngebut tiba-tiba. Hati-hati!
en: Bang Kilat, the rival courier, speeds by out of nowhere. Watch out!
Coin bonus (%d, also added to wallet)

keys: Kamu sudah sampai di Pos. Ambil paket pengganti dan lanjutkan perjalanan?
en: You reached a checkpoint. Take a replacement package and keep going?

keys: Pengiriman gagal. Upah hari ini hangus untuk ganti rugi.
en: Delivery failed. Today's pay goes to compensation.

keys: Paket VIP sampai di tangan Bu Direktur. Masbro resmi diangkat menjadi kurir tetap Ngacir Express, dan tabungannya cukup untuk menyembuhkan adiknya. Trobos Ajalah!
en: The VIP package reached the Director. Masbro is officially hired as a permanent Ngacir Express courier, and his savings are enough to cure his little sister. Just go for it!

keys: Tabungan masih kurang %s. Ulangi hari mana pun untuk memperbaiki upah. Upah terbaik tiap hari yang dihitung.
en: Savings are still %s short. Replay any day to improve your pay. Only each day's best pay counts.

keys: Masa percobaan berakhir, tapi tabungan Masbro belum cukup untuk biaya pengobatan adiknya. Besok ia harus mencari jalan lain.
en: The probation is over, but Masbro's savings aren't enough for his sister's treatment. Tomorrow he'll have to find another way.

keys: Paket agak penyok, tapi masih aman.
en: The package is a bit dented, but still fine.

keys: Paketnya sampai dengan baik, cuma agak lama.
en: It arrived in good shape, just a little slow.

keys: Masbro... paketnya rusak, tapi masih bisa diterima.
en: Masbro... it's damaged, but I'll take it.

keys: Mas... ini paket apa habis perang?
en: Dude... did this package go through a war?

keys: Sempurna. Saya jarang bilang begini, Masbro.
en: Perfect. I rarely say that, Masbro.

keys: Utuh, tapi saya tidak suka menunggu.
en: Intact, but I don't like waiting.

keys: Ada lecet. Saya catat di aplikasi.
en: There's a scratch. I'm noting it in the app.

keys: Ini jauh dari standar saya, Masbro.
en: This is far below my standards, Masbro.
I'll be speaking to your manager.

keys: Tekan W / panah atas (atau tap layar) untuk maju. Hindari kendaraan!
en: Press W / up arrow (or tap the screen) to move forward. Avoid the traffic!

keys: Aduh! Tiap tabrakan merusak paket. Kalau ikon paket di kiri atas habis, pengiriman gagal.
en: Ouch! Every crash damages the package. If the package icons at the top left run out, the delivery fails.

keys: Ambil koin! +Rp1.000 untuk upah, dan masuk dompet untuk belanja di Toko Masbro.
en: Grab coins! +Rp1,000 pay each, and they go to your wallet for Masbro's Shop.

keys: Power-up! Helm menahan 1 benturan, sepatu bikin langkah lebih cepat.
en: Power-up! A helmet blocks 1 hit, shoes make you step faster.

keys: Ada lubang di aspal. Terperosok bikin paket rusak, jadi lewati saja.
en: A pothole ahead. Falling in damages the package, so go around it.

keys: Sungai! Lompat ke atas rakit dan ikut arusnya. Jangan sampai tercebur.
en: A river! Hop onto a raft and ride the current. Don't fall in.

keys: Ini Pos. Kalau paket hancur setelah ini, kamu bisa lanjut dari sini.
en: This is a checkpoint. If the package breaks after this, you can continue from here.

keys: ETA hampir habis! Terlambat membuat upah dipotong per detik.
en: The ETA is almost up! Being late cuts your pay every second.

keys: Kucing dan pejalan kaki tidak merusak paket, tapi menghalangi. Cari jalur lain.
en: Cats and pedestrians don't damage the package, but they block you. Find another path.

keys: Itu Bang Kilat, kurir rival! Dia ngebut, jangan berdiri di lane-nya.
en: That's Bang Kilat, the rival courier! He speeds, so stay out of his lane.

keys: Empuk dan pemaaf. Tahan beberapa benturan, cocok untuk hari pertama.
en: Soft and forgiving. Survives a few bumps, perfect for day one.

keys: Berat! Langkah Masbro jadi lebih lambat. Atur timing menyeberang.
en: Heavy! Masbro walks slower. Time your crossings.

keys: Rapuh. Satu senggolan langsung bikin retak parah.
en: Fragile. A single bump cracks it badly.

keys: Barang mahal di tengah lalu lintas yang makin padat.
en: Expensive goods in ever heavier traffic.

keys: Paket terakhir masa percobaan. Satu goresan pun akan dicatat.
en: The last package of the probation. Every scratch will be noted.

keys: Bantalnya buat cucu saya. Hati-hati, Masbro!
en: The pillow is for my grandkid. Careful, Masbro!

keys: Air di rumah habis, galonnya ditunggu!
en: We're out of water at home, I need that jug!

keys: Telurnya harus utuh. Saya cek satu-satu.
en: The eggs must be intact. I'll check every one.

keys: Hujan begini... barangnya jangan sampai basah!
en: In this rain... don't let it get wet!
This is the decider, Masbro. I'm waiting.

keys: Suatu hari, hiduplah Masbro, seekor capybara santai yang tinggal berdua bersama adiknya di Kota Ngacir.
en: Once upon a time, there lived Masbro, a laid-back capybara who shared a home with his little sister in Ngacir City.

keys: Setiap hari, Masbro mencari rezeki dengan mengandalkan ketenangannya, demi memenuhi kebutuhan mereka berdua.
en: Every day, Masbro made a living with nothing but his calm nature, to provide for the two of them.

keys: Suatu ketika, adiknya jatuh sakit parah. Dokter bilang biaya pengobatannya besar, dan harus terkumpul dalam lima hari.
en: One day, his sister fell seriously ill. The doctor said the treatment was expensive, and the money had to be raised within five days.

keys: Karena itu, Masbro melamar di ekspedisi Ngacir Express. Ia harus lolos masa percobaan lima hari, mengantar paket-paket berisiko di tengah lalu lintas kota yang liar.
en: So Masbro applied at the Ngacir Express courier company. He has to pass a five-day probation, delivering risky packages through the city's wild traffic.

keys:
Kejar Timer ETA. Jaga paket dari benturan. Jangan sampai upah terpotong denda ganti rugi.

Trobos Ajalah!
en:
Beat the ETA timer. Keep the package safe from bumps. Don't let damage fines eat your pay.

Just go for it!

keys: Hari kedua. Demam adik belum juga turun.
en: Day two. His sister's fever still hasn't broken.

keys: Pesanan pagi ini: galon air untuk Pak Budi. Beratnya bukan main, tapi Masbro tetap santai.
en: This morning's order: a water jug for Mr. Budi. It's incredibly heavy, but Masbro stays chill.

keys: Hari ketiga. Kata kurir lain, Pak Ojan adalah pelanggan paling teliti di seluruh Kota Ngacir.
en: Day three. The other couriers say Mr. Ojan is the pickiest customer in all of Ngacir City.

keys: Hari ini ia memesan sekotak telur. Satu retak saja, ia pasti tahu.
en: Today he ordered a box of eggs. One crack, and he'll know.

keys: Hari keempat. Langit Kota Ngacir mendung sejak pagi, lalu hujan turun deras tepat di jam sibuk.
en: Day four. The sky over Ngacir City has been grey since morning, and then the rain pours down right at rush hour.

keys: Barang sensitif untuk Pak Joko tetap harus sampai. Jalanan licin, pandangan terbatas.
en: Mr. Joko's fragile goods still have to arrive. Slippery roads, poor visibility.
The last day of the probation.

keys: Bu Direktur sendiri yang memesan Paket VIP. Inilah penentuannya: diangkat jadi kurir tetap, atau pulang dengan tangan kosong.
en: The Director herself ordered the VIP package. This is it: become a permanent courier, or go home empty-handed.

keys: Sampai akhirnya, Paket VIP tiba di tangan Bu Direktur.
en: And finally, the VIP package arrived in the Director's hands.

keys: Masbro resmi diangkat menjadi kurir tetap Ngacir Express.
en: Masbro is officially hired as a permanent Ngacir Express courier.

keys: Tabungannya cukup untuk biaya pengobatan. Beberapa hari kemudian, adiknya sudah bisa tertawa lagi.
en: His savings cover the treatment. A few days later, his sister is laughing again.

keys: Masa percobaan berakhir, tapi tabungan Masbro belum cukup untuk biaya pengobatan adiknya.
en: The probation is over, but Masbro's savings aren't enough for his sister's treatment.

keys: Masbro menarik napas panjang. Besok ia akan mencari jalan lain, dengan tenang, seperti biasa.
en: Masbro takes a deep breath. Tomorrow he'll find another way, calmly, as always.
